boundary: The actual cyclotomic kernel is the fixing subgroup of Q(zeta_p), with same-action decomposition and inertia transport. The evaluated character kernel defines an actual number field, finite Galois over Q. Nonsplitting supplies a surjective character and thus a cyclic degree-p Galois extension of that same cyclotomic field, with conditional local fixedness of all field elements. Prime-ideal unramified predicates, class-group/unit eigenspace maps, Kummer twist/duality, global vanishing, full tower iteration and resonant-place geometry remain open; general hno is unfinished.
